### 👀 Code Review

Items that passed QA and are awaiting or undergoing review.

| ID | Item | Reviewer | PR Link | Status | Open Comments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| {WP-007} | {Description} | {Name / AI-assisted} | {URL} | Pending / In Review / Approved | {N} |

**Code Review checklist per item (fill before approving):**

#### {WP-007} — {Item Name}

```
Reviewer: {Name / "Self + AI review"}
Date: {YYYY-MM-DD}

Security:
□ No hardcoded secrets / API keys
□ Input validation present at all entry points
□ Logs do not expose sensitive data

Code quality:
□ Naming is descriptive and consistent with codebase
□ Error handling does not silently swallow exceptions
□ No dead code or commented-out blocks
□ No N+1 queries

Architecture:
□ Files placed in the correct folder (check FOLDER-STRUCTURE.md)
□ New dependencies reviewed (license, last update)
□ DB changes have a reversible migration
□ Does not violate decisions in DECISIONS.md

Anti-slop (from references/frontend/anti-slop-core.md):
□ [Checklist from anti-slop-core.md — open and fill from the source file]

Decision: APPROVE / REQUEST CHANGES
Notes: {Notes for developer}
```

### 🚀 Release *(if this sprint includes Release)*

**Release Configuration:**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Release Date | {YYYY-MM-DD} |
| Release Type | Major / Minor / Patch / Hotfix |
| Version | {vX.Y.Z} |
| Deployed by | {Name} |
| Rollback plan | {Link to rollback procedure or short description} |

**Pre-deployment checklist:**

```
□ UAT sign-off received in writing
□ Production database backup completed and verified (time: {HH:MM})
□ All production env vars set and verified
□ Migration script dry-run completed on staging with production-like data
□ Rollback script / plan available and previously tested
□ Maintenance window communicated to stakeholders
□ Monitoring dashboard open (Sentry, etc.)
```

**Deployment log:**

```
Deployment start: {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM}
Deployment end: {YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM}
Migration status: {Success / Error: description}
Deployment status: {Success / Rolled back: reason}
Post-deploy smoke test: Pass / Fail
```

**Post-deployment checklist:**

```
□ Smoke test: login, core features, critical integrations — all alive
□ Error monitoring: no new spikes in the first 30 minutes
□ Response time: normal (check dashboard)
□ Release notes sent to client / stakeholders
□ User manual sent if updated
□ Source code delivered if contract requires it
□ Maintenance phase information communicated
□ CHANGE-LOG.md and VERSION.md updated
```

```
Documentation updated:

□ KNOWN-ISSUES.md — P3/P4 not yet fixed
□ TECHNICAL-DEBT.md — shortcuts taken and their reasons
□ DECISIONS.md — architectural decisions made
```
